sloka: कैकेयीवचनं श्रुत्वा मन्थरा भृशदुःखिता ।दीर्घमुष्णं निःश्वस्य कैकेयीमिदमब्रवीत् ॥२-८-२०॥
transliteration: kaikeyīvacanaṁ śrutvā mantharā bhṛśaduḥkhitā ।dīrghamuṣṇaṁ niḥśvasya kaikeyīmidamabravīt ॥2-8-20॥

translations.english: Having heard Kaikeyi's words Manthara was extremely unhappy. Heaving deep, hot sighs she said to Kaikeyi.
